d:
In this interview, Surajbhan Singh talks about the murder of Dularchand Yadav, the growing tension in Mokama, and his views on Anant Singh and the upcoming Mokama elections.
He also shares his opinion on Lalu Yadav, the RJD, and the political situation in Bihar. His wife Veena Devi is contesting against Anant Singh of the JDU from the Mokama seat.
Watch this interview hosted by Bhupinder Soni to understand what Surajbhan Singh said about the murder, the politics, and the election battle in Mokama.
